name: Latent Mesmerism
body:
A talent for mental influence has awakened within you.

Prerequisite(s): You do not have the hypnotic focus class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to apply hypnotic focus, as the legendary mesmerist class feature, except it does not grant access to spells, will enforcement or a bonus feat. Your focus uses the rules for the opportunist focus. Its penalty cannot exceed -2. It cannot be doubled. If you later gain levels in a class that grants psychic spells, you lose this benefit, but add a 1st-level spell from the opportunist focus spell list to your class spell list and list of spells known.
